business_summary: RCM Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of business and technology solutions in the United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, Europe, and Philippines. The company operates through three segments: Engineering; Specialty Health Care; and Life Sciences, Data and Solutions (LS&D). It offers engineering services, including project management engineering, integrated design engineering, transmission and distribution power delivery, engineering analysis, engineering-procurement-construction, configuration management, hardware/software validation and verification, quality assurance, technical writing and publications, manufacturing process planning and improvement, and 3D/BIM integrated design. The company also provides long-term and short-term staffing, executive search, international recruitment, and placement solutions in the fields of allied and therapy staffing, correctional healthcare staffing, health information management, nursing services, physician and advanced practice, school staffing and recruitment, and telepractice. In addition, it offers enterprise business solutions, application development and support, IT infrastructure deployment and management, data solutions, digitization, human capital management solutions, as well as technology and business solutions for the life sciences industry and other specific verticals. The company serves aerospace/defense, educational institutions, energy, financial services, healthcare, life sciences, manufacturing and distribution, public sector, and technology. RCM Technologies, Inc. was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Pennsauken, New Jersey.
business_summary_ko: RCM Technologies, Inc.는 미국, 캐나다, 푸에르토리코, 유럽 및 필리핀에서 비즈니스 및 기술 솔루션 제공에 참여하고 있습니다. 회사는 세 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다: 엔지니어링; 전문 의료; 및 생명 과학, 데이터 및 솔루션(LS&D). 프로젝트 관리 엔지니어링, 통합 설계 엔지니어링, 송배전 전력 공급, 엔지니어링 분석, 엔지니어링-조달-구축, 구성 관리, 하드웨어/소프트웨어 검증 및 검증, 품질 보증, 기술 문서 작성 및 출판, 제조 프로세스 계획 및 개선, 3D/BIM 통합 설계를 포함한 엔지니어링 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 또한 연합 및 치료 인력, 교정 의료 인력, 건강 정보 관리, 간호 서비스, 의사 및 고급 진료, 학교 인력 및 채용, 원격 진료 분야에서 장기 및 단기 인력 채용, 임원 검색, 국제 채용 및 배치 솔루션을 제공합니다. 또한 엔터프라이즈 비즈니스 솔루션, 애플리케이션 개발 및 지원, IT 인프라 배포 및 관리, 데이터 솔루션, 디지털화 등을 제공합니다.
